purpose: Freeze the exact row, geometry, likelihood, nuisance, split and access contract without opening a scientific CF4 or VAST row.

parse_contract.line_endings: remove exactly one LF and optional preceding CR before record-length check
parse_contract.missing: all-space field maps to missing; every required-field missing value rejects the row; missing is never converted to zero
parse_contract.numeric: I fields accept optional leading minus then decimal digits; F fields must parse to finite decimal floats; NaN and infinity reject
parse_contract.predecode_checks: verify compressed source SHA256, decompressed record count and every fixed record length

geometry_join.sphere_join: inner join VAST_TABLE2 to surviving table1 void IDs on exact (Cosmo,void); duplicate sphere rows reject
geometry_join.union: analytic ray-sphere intervals are clipped to [0,D_path] and unioned, never summed
geometry_join.units: VAST h^-1 Mpc are divided by h=0.674 before law evaluation; D_path is Planck2018 comoving Mpc obtained only from CF4 Dist luminosity Mpc
geometry_join.coordinate_probe: all Planck2018 table1 rows must reproduce (x,y,z) from (RAdeg,DEdeg,s) within geometry-v2 frozen tolerances before any CF4 response field opens
geometry_join.full_mask_primary: RA/Dec mask pixel true, 0<=h*D_path<=332.3856506347656, and L_unobserved=0 exactly within 1e-10 Mpc
geometry_join.partial_mask: retain count and IDs as counterexamples but do not score

response_likelihood.baseline: s_FLRW=ln(1+z_D), where z_D is the frozen Planck2018 inversion of CF4 Dist luminosity Mpc
response_likelihood.distance_check: DMzp and Dist must pass geometry-v3 dual-rounding identity
response_likelihood.likelihood: independent Gaussian in s residual conditional on frozen nuisance design; no published Vpec field is parsed
response_likelihood.law: delta_H grid -20 to +20 km/s/Mpc inclusive in 0.25 increments; prediction delta_H*L_void_Mpc/c
response_likelihood.primary_score: development profile delta-chi-square versus delta_H=0; validation reports frozen signed delta_H and Gaussian log-likelihood difference
response_likelihood.permutation: 10000 development permutations of L_void within ten deterministic equal-count Dist strata; PCG64 seed 902104729

flow_nuisance.design_velocity_units: a_D*D_path + B dot n + D_path*n^T S n
flow_nuisance.a_D: one distance-rate coefficient absorbing H_m*D and distance-scale drift
flow_nuisance.S: five coefficients of a symmetric trace-free shear tensor
flow_nuisance.priors: independent zero-mean Gaussian: sigma(a_D)=20 km/s/Mpc, sigma(B_i)=500 km/s, sigma(S_i)=20 km/s/Mpc
flow_nuisance.same_design: identical nuisance columns and priors under null and delta_H alternatives

split_and_access.split: SHA256 of canonical positive 1PGC ASCII digits; unsigned big-endian digest[0:8] modulo 10; 0-5 development, 6-7 validation, 8-9 confirmation
split_and_access.groupwise: one 1PGC appears in exactly one role and duplicate 1PGC rows reject
split_and_access.IDS_PARTITIONED: decode CF4 bytes 1-7 only; all remaining CF4 bytes stay opaque; VAST still opaque
split_and_access.DEVELOPMENT_OPEN: decode full CF4 fields only for development IDs; decode frozen VAST predictor geometry; validation and confirmation CF4 rows retain only hashes and byte offsets
split_and_access.VALIDATION_OPEN: allowed only after development law/nuisance/grid/parser receipt is immutable; confirmation remains opaque
split_and_access.CONFIRMATION_OPEN: not authorized by this contract and requires a new explicit release receipt after validation decision freeze
split_and_access.abort: any hash, schema, count, duplicate, coordinate, mask, distance, finite-value or minimum-count failure aborts without scoring

excluded.CF4_TABLE3: not decoded in the primary screen
excluded.VAST_TABLE3: not decoded in the primary screen
excluded.claim: correlation-only; no mechanism, novelty or publication claim
